svg.title: Rotating and inertial views of a merry-go-round
svg.desc: Top views of counterclockwise rotation. In the rotating frame an outward fictitious centrifugal force balances the inward real force for a rider at rest. In the inertial frame a held rider has a real inward centripetal force; a separate unshaded released rider has zero net horizontal force and follows a straight tangent. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.
